title: Prediction
description: Predict what useful validation should provide.
prompt: A form disables the submit button when the email is invalid, but it does not show any message. What is the main problem?

options.label: There is no problem because invalid data cannot be submitted.
The user may not know what is wrong or how to fix it.

responses.no-problem: Not quite. Blocking invalid data is only part of validation. Users still need clear recovery guidance.
responses.no-recovery-guidance: Correct. Good validation explains the problem near the field and helps the user recover.
responses.state-breaks: Not quite. Validation UI does not stop React state from updating.

metadata.reason: Catches the misconception that validation is only about preventing submit.
